privacy.collect.captain.en: Your ward-captain application, if you send one — the ward you would cover, an optional organisation, a short note, and how many volunteers you could bring. We contact you about it only through Hawkeye alerts (the in-app feed, push, and Telegram if you linked it), never by phone. It is deleted with your account.
privacy.collect.captain.ha: Buƙatarka ta zama kyaftin na unguwa, idan ka aika — unguwar da za ka kula da ita, ƙungiya (na zaɓi), ɗan gajeren bayani, da adadin masu sa kai da za ka iya kawowa. Muna tuntuɓarka game da ita ta sanarwar Hawkeye kaɗai (jerin sanarwar manhajar, sanarwar push, da Telegram idan ka haɗa shi), ba ta kiran waya ba. Za a goge ta idan ka goge asusunka.
privacy.collect.captain.ig: Arịrịọ gị ịbụ onye ndú ward, ọ bụrụ na i zitere ya — ward ị ga-elekọta, nzukọ (nhọrọ), obere ederede, na ọnụọgụ ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo ị nwere ike iweta. Anyị na-akpọtụrụ gị gbasara ya naanị site na ọkwa Hawkeye (ebe ọkwa nke ngwa ahụ, ọkwa push, na Telegram ma ọ bụrụ na i jikọrọ ya), ọ bụghị site n'oku ekwentị. A na-ehichapụ ya ma ọ bụrụ na i hichapụ akaụntụ gị.
privacy.collect.captain.yo: Ìbéèrè rẹ láti di olùdarí àgọ́, tí o bá fi ránṣẹ́ — àgọ́ tí o máa bójú tó, àjọ kan (àṣàyàn), àkọsílẹ̀ kúkúrú, àti iye àwọn olùyọ̀ǹda tí o lè mú wá. Ìkìlọ̀ Hawkeye nìkan ni a fi ń kàn sí ọ nípa rẹ̀ (àtòjọ ìkìlọ̀ inú ohun èlò náà, ìkìlọ̀ push, àti Telegram tí o bá so ó pọ̀), kì í ṣe nípa pípe fóònù. A máa pa á rẹ́ tí o bá pa àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ rẹ́.
